pages.text: Please. Do not light the others. Put down whatever you carry. Go back through the border while you still remember the sun, while you still remember your own name. You think I am guarding a lie. I am guarding a door, and you are what stands on the wrong side of it. I have stood here for longer than I can count, and I am so tired. I do not want to fight you. But if you call me, I will come.
